name: Akizuki Rinna
source:
3rd year high school student & professional manga artist.
Hobby: Drawing manga, Shopping
A student and girl manga artist in the same class as Kenji.
Like Kenji, she serialises her work in Comic Charm. Her work is so popular that it ranked first in a reader survey. She serialises her work under her real name, not a pen name, so she is well-known at school. She is very popular with both boys and girls. She is thought to be a genius, but she works very hard behind the scenes. She is cheerful and friendly to those around her, and is unconcerned about Alice's popularity. However, in reality she is very competitive, and is so jealous of Alice's popularity that she will crack walls and other things. Not knowing that Kenji is a manga artist, she sees him as "a friend who understands the feelings of a manga artist very well."
